                                       ORDINANCE


BE I f ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1 Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is
hereby amended by changing all of RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 17-G in the area bounded by:

       West Touhy Avenue; North Sheridan Road; a line 135.10 feet South of and
       parallel to West Touhy Avenue; the public alley next West of North
       Sheridan Road.

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.




Common Address of Property:            7138 North Sheridan Road/1313 West Touhy Avenue
